meta.title: The Last Pour
meta.logline: A palace server who spent years pouring honey wine for the emperor, unnoticed, is called by his name for one night.

style.block: Warm 35mm film aesthetic with amber candlelight, rich golden honey reflections, crisp white linen textures, and soft architectural shadows.

characters.description: Young Ethiopian man in his twenties, slim build, close-cropped black hair, wearing a clean, plain white cotton server tunic and trousers, with quiet, watchful, dignified eyes.
Older Ethiopian man in his fifties, heavy build, short peppered hair, dressed in a tailored dark formal cape over white linens, with a sharp, dismissive expression.
a short, elderly Ethiopian man with a very upright, composed posture and a calm, attentive gaze, in a plain dark formal cloak; seen at a distance, from behind or in profile, never in close-up

en.style: warm, unhurried, intimate, like telling a story to family

am.style: warm, unhurried, intimate, like telling a story to family

shots.reason: Establishes the quiet routine and humble environment where Tesfaye begins his day of palace service.
shots.image_prompt: Centered wide shot of tesfaye arranging glass flasks in a stone palace kitchen before dawn, illuminated by the warm amber glow of oil lamps with deep shadows in the background.

motion.prompt: Slow gentle push in toward the center

narration.en: For years, he served the emperor. They called him the honey wine server.
narration.am: ለብዙ ዓመታት ንጉሠ ነገሥቱን አገለገለ። የጠጅ አሳላፊው እያሉ ይጠሩት ነበር።

shots.reason: Shows the craft and steady precision of serving honey wine into the traditional glass flask.
shots.image_prompt: Centered insert shot of golden honey wine pouring in a thin, perfectly steady stream into a traditional glass berele flask resting on a wooden surface under warm lamp light.

motion.prompt: Static camera as honey wine pours smoothly into the glass flask with rising micro-bubbles

narration.en: He knew how to pour without spilling a single drop.
narration.am: አንዲት ጠብታ እንኳን ሳያፈስስ መቅዳት ጠንቅቆ ያውቃል።

shots.reason: Introduces Tesfaye's composed and watchful demeanour as he prepares to serve unnoticed.
shots.image_prompt: Centered medium close-up of tesfaye holding a serving tray at chest height, looking forward with quiet dignity in a dimly lit palace corridor.

motion.prompt: Very slow lateral pan to the left across the frame

narration.en: And he knew how to disappear quietly into the room.
narration.am: በአዳራሹ ውስጥም ሳይታወቅ በዝምታ መሰወርን ያውቅበታል።

shots.reason: Sets the stage of the formal evening banquet and the grandeur surrounding the unnoticed server.
shots.image_prompt: Centered wide shot of a long formal palace banquet table covered in white linen and glowing candlelight, with great_emperor seated at the head in the distance in profile.

motion.prompt: Slow smooth pull out revealing the depth of the banquet hall

narration.en: One night, at a formal gathering, guests filled the long tables.
narration.am: አንድ ምሽት በታላቅ ግብዣ ላይ ረዣዥሞቹ ማዕዶች በእንግዶች ተሞልተው ነበር።

shots.reason: Captures the dismissive arrogance of the nobleman questioning Tesfaye's significance.
shots.image_prompt: Centered medium shot of banquet_guest seated at the banquet table beside candlelit glasses, turning sideways with a thin smirk.

motion.prompt: Slow drift panning right with a subtle push in

narration.en: A guest asked whether the emperor even knew his name.
narration.am: አንድ እንግዳም ‘ንጉሡ ስምህን እንኳ ያውቁታል ወይ?’ ሲል ጠየቀው።

shots.reason: Shows Tesfaye absorbing the mockery with silent restraint and wounded pride.
shots.image_prompt: Centered medium close-up of tesfaye standing beside the banquet table, slowly lowering his eyes in silence under soft candlelight.

motion.prompt: Static camera as the server gently lowers his gaze and holds his breath in composure

narration.en: He lowered his eyes in silence, and said nothing.
narration.am: እርሱ ግን ዓይኖቹን አቀረቀረ፤ ምንም አልመለሰም።

shots.reason: Shows the emperor taking notice and commanding the hall to honor the server.
shots.image_prompt: Centered wide shot framed from behind great_emperor at the head of the banquet table, as he raises his glass toward the room in warm candle glow.

motion.prompt: Slow push in toward the head of the banquet table

narration.en: The great emperor set down his glass and asked for his name.
narration.am: ታላቁ ንጉሥ ጽዋቸውን አስቀምጠው ስሙን ጠየቁት።

shots.reason: Highlights the pivotal emotional breakthrough as Tesfaye is recognized by name.
shots.image_prompt: Centered close-up of tesfaye looking up with glistening eyes, struggling to contain an overwhelming emotion amidst soft background candlelight.

motion.prompt: Subtle handheld tremor as the subject takes a slow, shaky breath with glistening eyes

narration.en: Hearing Tesfaye, he raised a toast, and the whole hall lifted their glasses.
narration.am: «ተስፋዬ» መባሉን ሲሰሙ ለክብሩ ጽዋ አነሡ፤ መላው አዳራሽም አብሮ ጽዋውን አነሣ።

shots.reason: Reflects the intimate ritual of his final pour after the hall has emptied.
shots.image_prompt: Centered insert shot of a single glass berele flask filled with golden honey wine resting on a stone windowsill beside a solitary candle.

motion.prompt: Slow lateral pan to the left keeping the glowing glass centered

narration.en: My grandmother said he spent his life serving the emperor.
narration.am: አያቴ እንደነገረችኝ ሙሉ ዘመኑን ያሳለፈው ንጉሠ ነገሥቱን በማገልገል ነበር።

shots.reason: Concludes the film on Tesfaye's quiet private pride and transformed dignity.
shots.image_prompt: Centered medium shot of tesfaye standing alone in an open stone palace archway at night, holding a berele flask and gazing out at distant city lights.

motion.prompt: Gentle forward camera drift as the subject slowly brings the glass to his lips looking out

narration.en: But that night, for one moment, the whole room remembered the man behind the tray.
narration.am: ነገር ግን በዚያች ምሽት፣ ለአንድ ቅጽበት፣ መላው አዳራሽ ከትሪው ጀርባ የነበረውን ሰው አስታወሰው።

cues.caption: Gentle, understated acoustic strings with soft traditional krar notes, warm and meditative under spoken narration.

lines: Inspired by a family story. Some scenes are imagined.
